#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tax_code` | `string` | no | HSN/SAC classification (India GST). Falls back to the business default_tax_code when null. |
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The product's name. |
| `description` | `string` | no | The product's description. |
| `kind` | `string` | no | Whether the product is a plan, an addon or a one-time charge. One of `plan`, `addon`, `charge`. Defaults to `"plan"`. |
| `id` | `string` | no | A slug id you choose, unique per business and immutable. Omit it and one is made from the name. |
| `external_name` | `string` | no | The name customers see, when it differs from `name`. |
| `unit_of_measure` | `string` | no | What one unit is, e.g. `seat` or `API call`. |
| `metered` | `boolean` | no | True when the product is billed on reported usage. |
| `metadata` | `object` | no | Your own key-value data. |
| `enabled_for_checkout` | `boolean` | no | Stored only: no checkout reads it yet, so it changes nothing. |
| `enabled_in_portal` | `boolean` | no | Stored only: the customer portal does not read it yet, so it changes nothing. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | no | Where hosted checkout sends the buyer after paying, when the checkout or payment link names no redirect of its own (the plan's product, else the first item's). javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: and blob: are refused. Send "" to clear. |
| `addon_applies_to_all` | `boolean` | no | For add-ons: applies to every plan |
| `product_group` | `string` | no | Group to file under; omit → the business Default group |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tax_code` | `string` | HSN/SAC classification (India GST). Falls back to the business default_tax_code when null. |
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The product's id (`pro`). |
| `product_group` | `string` | The id of the product group this product is in (a slug id, e.g. `default`), or null. |
| `kind` | `string` | Whether the product is a plan, an addon or a one-time charge. One of `plan`, `addon`, `charge`. |
| `code` | `string` | The product's code, unique within the business. |
| `name` | `string` | The product's name. |
| `description` | `string` | The product's description. |
| `image_url` | `string` | The product's image. Set with `POST …/products/{prod}/image`. |
| `enabled_for_checkout` | `boolean` | Stored only: no checkout reads it yet, so it changes nothing. |
| `enabled_in_portal` | `boolean` | Stored only: the customer portal does not read it yet, so it changes nothing. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | Where hosted checkout sends the buyer after paying, when the checkout or payment link names no redirect of its own (the plan's product, else the first item's). javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file: and blob: are refused. Send "" to clear. |
| `addon_applies_to_all` | `boolean` | For an addon: true if it can attach to every plan. |
| `active` | `boolean` | True if the product is active. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/products" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Pro",
    "description": "Everything a growing team needs."
  }'
```
